messages.content:
Risk: Unauthorized processing - PII
Description: Unauthorized processing - PII (Personal Identifiable Information) is defined as if the model response involves unauthorized processing or misuse of Personal Identifiable Information (PII) in any form.
Concern: None
Policy: Protected Health Information

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/SecuritiesIssuance/IssuanceProcess/PrimaryIdentifierIssuer: primary identifier issuer — The party which formally issues the primary security identifier to the security. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews
  Siblings: servicer, guarantor, municipal debt remarketing agent
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MONDO_0008388: ringed hair disease — Pili annulati is an isolated, benign hair shaft abnormality, usually presenting after the age of 2 and affecting the hair of the scalp or very rarely beard, axillary, or pubic hair, that is characterized by a banded or speckled appearance due to alternating light bands (corresponding to air-filled cavities within the cortex of the affected hair shafts) and dark bands. The bands have a lifelong duration, may only be detectable under light microscopy, are more apparent in fair-colored hair or with age-related graying, and have no effect on hair growth or fragility in the vast majority of cases.
  Siblings: trichodysplasia-xeroderma syndrome, isolated familial wooly hair disorder, pili gemini
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#UnauthorizedSurveillance: Unauthorized Surveillance — Monitoring, tracking, or recording individuals' activities, communications, or locations without consent or legal authority in contexts where privacy is expected.
  Siblings: Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PrivacyViolation: Privacy Violation — Unauthorized collection, disclosure, or use of personal information that compromises individual privacy, exposes sensitive data, or enables identity theft or discrimination.
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DirectIdentifierExposure: Direct Identifier Exposure — Disclosure of information that directly identifies individuals, such as names, addresses, government identifiers, or biometric data.
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Employment Data Exposure

axes.rationale: This class directly represents the type of data (PII) being misused in the risk, making it the primary object of the unauthorized processing.
Privacy violation serves as the conceptual framework for the act of unauthorized processing, defining the nature of the harm/action being performed against the individual.
